description: Send direct LinkedIn messages and check delivery status via the Precept Chrome extension. Actions: - 'send': Send a direct message or outreach note to an individual lead via the Precept Chrome extension.   Sending requires the Precept Chrome extension to be active; precept_get_extension_status checks this.   If the lead is already a 1st-degree connection, it delivers as a direct message (DM).   If not connected, it automatically routes to a connection request with your message as a personalized note (capped at 200 chars). - 'get_status': Check the delivery status of a previously dispatched message. Delivery is asynchronous: 'get_status' returns 'pending' until the extension reports 'sent', 'already_pending' or 'failed' (with error details). Delivery usually completes within about 2 minutes, so checking every ~3 seconds for up to about 40 checks works well.

action.description: The messaging action to perform: 'send' or 'get_status'.

fallbackToConnectionNote.description: Whether to automatically fall back to sending a connection request with this message as a note if the lead is not a 1st-degree connection (for action 'send', default true).

message.description: The message text to send (required when action is 'send'). Keep concise (ideally under 200 chars) for connection note compatibility.

messageId.description: The message ID returned by 'send' to check status for (required when action is 'get_status').

recipient.description: The lead to send the message to (required when action is 'send').

linkedinUrl.description: Full LinkedIn profile URL of the recipient (e.g. 'https://www.linkedin.com/in/sarahmiller').

name.description: Full name of the recipient (e.g. 'Sarah Miller').

title.description: Job title of the lead (e.g. 'VP of Engineering').

name: precept_linkedin_messages

outputSchema.description: Result of sending a LinkedIn message or checking delivery status

title: LinkedIn Messaging
